correctness.rationale: The exact finite formula follows by conditioning on a tagged Dirichlet coordinate and integrating an inclusion–exclusion conditional maximum, with all powers and ranges explicit. Convexity of its conditional mean forces exactly two derivative changes and, using the beta decreasing-density inequality, a unique zero in (1/m,1/2) for m>=3; m=2 is explicit. The asymptotic follows from an exact exponential-comparison formula and a gamma concentration sandwich uniform in z up to 3 log log m, yielding m t_m=log log m+log log log m+o(1). 13,112 exact/numerically controlled finite checker comparisons passed; the analytic proof, not the finite checks, supports infinity.

value.rationale: The count of long spacings is a natural coverage connectivity statistic and the maximum is the extreme gap. Their covariance reverses despite negative simplex dependence; the theorem gives an exact all-size sign classification and identifies an unexpected log-log / log-log-log crossover far below the Gumbel longest-gap scale. At this crossover the expected long-gap count diverges like m/(log m log log m), connecting the dependence transition to an extensive coverage regime, rather than reporting an arbitrary finite computation.
